RWA_REGIONS.name: South America
RWA_REGIONS.commodityDetail: The world's most traded agricultural commodity — Brazil alone produces 40% of global supply.

RWA_REGIONS.name: USA
RWA_REGIONS.commodityDetail: The backbone of American agriculture — from ethanol to livestock feed to the global food supply.

RWA_REGIONS.name: Australia
RWA_REGIONS.commodityDetail: Australia is one of the world's top wheat exporters — the golden grain of the Lucky Country.

RWA_REGIONS.name: Europe
RWA_REGIONS.commodityDetail: Europe's twin pillars — the vineyards of France and Italy, the wheat fields of Ukraine and France.

RWA_REGIONS.name: Africa
RWA_REGIONS.commodityDetail: West Africa produces 70% of the world's cocoa. Ethiopia is the birthplace of coffee itself.

RWA_REGIONS.name: Russia
RWA_REGIONS.commodityDetail: Russia is the world's largest wheat exporter and a dominant force in global energy markets.

RWA_REGIONS.name: India
RWA_REGIONS.commodityDetail: India feeds the world with rice and brews its soul into tea — two commodities that define a civilisation.

RWA_REGIONS.name: Japan
RWA_REGIONS.commodityDetail: Japan's culinary identity is inseparable from its tea ceremony and its mastery of the sea's harvest.

RWA_REGIONS.name: China
RWA_REGIONS.commodityDetail: The origin of tea and the world's largest rice producer — China's commodities shaped global civilisation.
